name: Scrap Circle
character: Walnut and leftovers: crumb quilts, string blocks, and a guild that treats the scrap bin as the stash.

sections.title: Nothing goes in the trash if it will make a 1.5-inch square
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: {{guild_name}} sews crumb, string, and postage-stamp quilts. We meet {{meeting_info}}.

sections.note: The scrap bins open thirty minutes early. Take what you will use. Leave what you will not.

items.title: Crumb night
items.body: No pattern. A bag of bits, a leader-and-ender, and a design wall.

items.title: String blocks
items.body: Newspaper foundations optional. We keep a stack of 8-inch papers by the iron.

items.title: Charity from leftovers
items.body: Finished crumb tops go to the children's hospital. They like the busy prints.

sections.title: Bring a bag of scraps, not a fat quarter bundle
A guild for leftover fabric
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: We formed because the other guilds in town were buying new solids for every BOM.

sections.html:
{{guild_name}} meets {{meeting_info}} in {{city}}. The program is usually a string-block demo or a crumb-quilt show and tell. New fabric is allowed. Boasting about yardage is not.

The library is a wall of bins labeled by color, not by designer. Take a scoop. Bring a scoop back.

items.quote: I used to throw selvedges away. Now they are the binding on a charity quilt.
items.author: Pat R.

items.quote: Nobody asks what the original pattern was. That is the point.
items.author: Chris M.

sections.title: Scrap night
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: The extra evening between meetings. Bins out, irons hot, no business.

sections.html: Scrap night is listed on the events page. Bring a bag of leftovers or use the guild bins. We do not cut into yardage that still has a bolt fold. Crumbs, strings, and orphan blocks only.

sections.title: Membership
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Dues buy batting for charity tops and keep the scrap bins stocked.

items.q: Do I have to sew crumbs?
items.a: No. String blocks, postage stamps, and orphan-block medallions all count. The rule is leftover fabric, not a technique.

items.q: Can I donate scraps without joining?
items.a: Yes. Leave a labeled bag at any meeting. Join if you want the bins and the newsletter.
